task_spec: Implement add_business_days(start, n): the date n business days after start, counting only Monday-Friday and skipping Saturday and Sunday.

bugs.description: weekday() returns 0=Mon .. 5=Sat .. 6=Sun, so `<= 5` counts SATURDAY as a business day (only Sunday is skipped). The condition must be `< 5` (or `<= 4`). add_business_days(Friday, 1) returns Saturday instead of Monday, and the drift compounds over longer spans.

provenance.note: subtle bug requiring reasoning/domain knowledge to catch
